[red bold]-- DEVICE PIN ERROR -- main.volt:5[/red bold]

`HCSR04` needs pins trig, echo. Missing: trig, echo.

 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin gpio_pin: Output = 4
 [dim]5 |[/dim]     device hcsr04: HCSR04 on gpio_pin at 4
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]           ^^^^^^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: `device hcsr04: HCSR04(trig: <gpio>, echo: <gpio>)`[/cyan]
